issues.legal_issue: Sections 4 to 24 of the Limitation Act are not wholly excluded when calculating the limitation period under Section 34(3) of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act; each provision applies unless expressly or impliedly excluded.

Section 4 of the Limitation Act applies to a Section 34(3) application when the three-month prescribed limitation period expires on a court holiday, but not when only the additional 30-day condonable period expires during a court holiday.
Section 10 of the General Clauses Act does not apply to a Section 34(3) application because the Limitation Act applies to those proceedings.

A Section 34 application filed after the 30-day condonable period has expired cannot be entertained when that period ends during a court vacation, even if the application is filed on the court’s reopening.
